name: sdk
description: Typed SDK client (W059): the deterministic projection of the api route table — one method per route (derived camelCase names over the stable lineage names, canonical order), compile-time drift-guarded against the route contracts (satisfies + Exclude over the default table's literal route names — a drifted table stops type-checking) and run-time drift-guarded over any table (assertSdkSurfaceCoversRouteTable). Request builders enforce the §14 scope law (the explicit tenant/project/world members each route demands, exactly those, none blank), the path law and the closed field schemas (W050's own isLegalCutoff + TIME_MACHINE_FAMILIES gates); response validators RE-VALIDATE every payload against the route's response schema including the W028 provenance citation match — the SDK never trusts the wire. Prepared requests are content-addressed (sdkreq-<digest>, A9). A14: no network I/O — the transport is W062's.
